passages_extracted.quote: It is not necessary to change the dose on the day before surgery. However, on the day of surgery, they should be replaced by those of intermediate and fast action. To minimize the risk of hypoglycemia caused by the fast-acting component, the dose of each type of insulin should be given independently.

passages_extracted.quote: The management of anti-hyperglycemic and anti-hypertensive agents should be individualized with the assistance of the prescribing clinician based on the timing of the colonoscopy and is beyond the scope of this document.

decisions.formulation: single child group for the fixed 70/30 protamine/aspart premix after the parent insulin-aspart group was split
decisions.conflict: Austrian Diabetes Association recommends conversion from mixed insulin to long-acting insulin at about two-thirds of the original mixed-insulin dose for routine operations; the Brazilian anesthesiology review instead separates the premix into intermediate and fast components and reduces the intermediate component. Preserve both strategies without averaging.
decisions.colonoscopy_context: USMSTF explicitly leaves antihyperglycemic management to individualized prescriber-assisted planning.

remains: Submit schema_version 1 package with explicit day-of-procedure conflict.
